concerns: Level 2: shared family module extractors/community_calendar.py (new file) used by eans.py and theabn.py. Rationale: the harness proved the two Community Calendar pages are the same YourMembership markup (span#EventList<id>, dd/mm/yyyy [» dd/mm/yyyy], Location line; detail #SpTitleBar, bold date line, When/Where rows, body after 'Go to Upcoming Event List'); parsing was verified identical on 3 EANS and 3 ABN detail pages. Each society file is constants only (ROOT, SOCIETY, DEFAULT_SPECIALTY) plus EANS's extra_shells hook.

Listing: 24 rows over 2 pages (15 + 9; page 3 empty). 23 shells = 24 - 2 rows already running (start before today: 'SURGICAL APPROACHES TO CRANIO-VERTEBRAL JUNCTION' 26/01-18/12/2026 and '2nd LEVEL MASTERS' COURSE' 02/03-18/12/2026, both logged and dropped by the 'upcoming only' rule; the owner may want rolling programmes like these kept) + 1 extra (EANS Congress 2027). Shell counts normal and forced-fallback both 23.

EANS Annual Congress (Level 2 addition): not in the calendar; parsed deterministically from the 'Future Congresses' bullets on /page/EANS_Congress (only editions with a full day range; 2028 'October Krakow' is skipped until dated). booking_url is the congress page, which carries one edition at a time, so when 2027 passes the same source_url will carry the next edition. The 2027 congress microsite is not linked yet, so no organiser_url/fees.

Relevance: all calendar categories (EANS events, training courses, national society events, congresses, community events) are neurosurgery meetings for clinicians; kept. Administrative/fundraising titles would be dropped and logged (none today).

Fees: none on any calendar page tested; Of the 9 detail pages opened, most carry an external Info/Registration/Website link (set as organiser_url). Harness coverage fires PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK on those (German Spine Congress dwg-kongress.de, Mistakes on the Lake mistakeonthelake.it, London 2033647): empty pricing_tiers is justified for the page text and the nav, but the external hop is not proven in the pipeline because of the discovery budget issue below (checked with a scratch discover() run on 2052634: only same-site fetch_failed steps ran).

Shared-file ask (Level 3, not done): extractors/discovery.py `_fetch_html` is httpx-only and never launches Playwright, so same-site sub-pages on Cloudflare-challenged hosts (eans.org, theabn.org) return fetch_failed (observed with a scratch discover() run: Register.aspx / attendees.asp / /page/concessions all fetch_failed), and those failed same-site fetches use up the 2-fetch budget before the organiser_url external hop is tried (EANS Functional Neurosurgery Course: qssimulationcentre.com never fetched). Suggested: try `organiser_url` first, or do not count fetch_failed against max_html, or allow a browser fetch for hosts the extractor marks challenged. The external hop does work when it runs (WFNS spinalkurs.org: followed, identity strong, no fees on that page).

HQ LESSON #95: regexes accept single or double quotes (WFNS raw HTML uses single quotes, the rendered DOM double); extract_detail reads page.content() (the rendered DOM the pipeline sees) and only falls back to fetch_html when the page lacks the markup.
Terms/robots: see theabn concerns (YourMembership legal link is privacy only; robots disallows only /global_inc/ and /global_engine/).

Taxonomy ask: society code 'EANS' (European Association of Neurosurgical Societies, international, Europe) in societies.ts. Specialty is the fixed society field 'Neurosurgery' (the shared classifier tagged spine courses as musculoskeletal). event_type is left to the merge layer's title heuristic.
Requests to eans.org over development + both harness runs: about 40 (probe pages 12, harness runs 2 x (3 listing + 1 congress + 1 base + details)); at the budget limit, sequential.
